scholarships.name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students
scholarships.provider: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
scholarships.amountNote: ₹12,000/year (UG, first 3 years); ₹20,000/year (PG)
scholarships.specialEligibility: Above 80th percentile of successful candidates in Class 12 (own board & stream)
scholarships.description: Merit-cum-means scholarship for students in the top 20 percentile of their Class 12 board who are in regular UG/PG courses. 50% of slots are for girls; SC/ST/OBC reservation applies.
scholarships.process: Apply (fresh or renewal) on the National Scholarship Portal; institute and board verify. Renewal needs 50% marks and 75% attendance.

scholarships.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste Students
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
scholarships.amountNote: Tuition & non-refundable fees reimbursed + monthly academic allowance (rate depends on course group)
scholarships.deadlineNote: Set by each state; usually Oct–Dec
scholarships.description: Centrally sponsored scheme that funds SC students for any recognised post-matric course, from Class 11 to PhD. Implemented through state SC welfare departments.
scholarships.process: Apply on NSP or your state's scholarship portal (e.g. MahaDBT); funds are paid by DBT.

scholarships.name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students
scholarships.provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
scholarships.amountNote: ₹50,000/year (degree: up to 4 years; diploma: up to 3 years)
scholarships.specialEligibility: Girl students; up to two girls per family; first year (or lateral-entry second year) of an AICTE-approved technical course
scholarships.description: AICTE scheme for students in AICTE-approved technical degree or diploma courses. Girl students; up to two girls per family.
scholarships.process: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal; the institute verifies the application.

scholarships.name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship for Specially-Abled Students
scholarships.provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
scholarships.amountNote: ₹50,000/year (degree: up to 4 years; diploma: up to 3 years)
scholarships.specialEligibility: Benchmark disability of 40% or more; first year (or lateral-entry second year) of an AICTE-approved technical course
scholarships.description: AICTE scheme for students in AICTE-approved technical degree or diploma courses. Benchmark disability of 40% or more.
scholarships.process: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal; the institute verifies the application.

scholarships.name: AICTE Swanath Scholarship
scholarships.provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
scholarships.amountNote: ₹50,000/year (degree: up to 4 years; diploma: up to 3 years)
scholarships.specialEligibility: Orphans, wards of parents who died of COVID-19, or wards of martyred armed forces / CAPF personnel; first year (or lateral-entry second year) of an AICTE-approved technical course
scholarships.description: AICTE scheme for students in AICTE-approved technical degree or diploma courses. Orphans, wards of parents who died of COVID-19, or wards of martyred armed forces / CAPF personnel.
scholarships.process: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal; the institute verifies the application.

scholarships.name: AICTE PG Scholarship (GATE / GPAT / CEED)
scholarships.provider: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
scholarships.amountNote: ₹12,400/month for up to 24 months
scholarships.specialEligibility: Valid GATE, GPAT or CEED score; admitted to an AICTE-approved M.E./M.Tech/M.Arch/M.Pharm/M.Des
scholarships.description: Monthly stipend for GATE/GPAT/CEED-qualified students in AICTE-approved full-time postgraduate programmes.
scholarships.process: The institute registers eligible students on AICTE's PG scholarship portal; stipend paid monthly by DBT.

scholarships.name: National Overseas Scholarship for SC Students
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
scholarships.amountNote: Full tuition + US$15,400/yr maintenance (UK: £9,900) + contingency, airfare, visa and insurance
scholarships.deadlineNote: Round 1 Feb–Mar, Round 2 Sep–Oct (40 days each)
scholarships.specialEligibility: Unconditional offer from a QS top-500 university; age 35 or under; 30% of awards for women
scholarships.description: Government of India scholarship for SC (also denotified/nomadic tribes and landless labourer families) students pursuing a master's or PhD abroad.
scholarships.process: Apply online at nosmsje.gov.in in one of two rounds; selection on merit within category quotas.

scholarships.name: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)
scholarships.specialEligibility: Top 1% in Class 12 board, or JEE-Advanced/NEET top 10,000, or admission to IISER/NISER/CEBS; age 17–22
scholarships.description: DST scholarship with mentorship for talented students pursuing BSc/MSc (or integrated MS) in the natural and basic sciences.
documents: Eligibility Proof (board top-1% certificate or rank card)
scholarships.process: Apply on the online-inspire.gov.in portal once the annual call is announced.

scholarships.name: Top Class Education Scheme for SC Students
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
scholarships.amountNote: Full tuition (capped at ₹2 lakh/yr in private institutes) + ₹86,000 first-year allowance (₹41,000 later years)
scholarships.specialEligibility: Admission to a notified premier institution (IITs, IIMs, NITs, AIIMS, NLUs etc.); 30% slots for girls
scholarships.description: Covers full fees and living, book and computer costs for SC students who secure admission to notified top-class institutions.
scholarships.process: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal; the institution verifies.

scholarships.name: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme (PMSS) for Wards of Ex-Servicemen
scholarships.provider: Kendriya Sainik Board, Ministry of Defence
scholarships.amountNote: ₹3,000/month for girls, ₹2,500/month for boys (paid annually)
scholarships.specialEligibility: Dependent wards/widows of ex-servicemen and ex-Coast Guard personnel; first year of a professional/technical course (MBA/MCA also allowed)
scholarships.description: Scholarship for wards and widows of ex-servicemen and ex-Coast Guard personnel pursuing professional degree courses.
scholarships.process: Apply online on the Kendriya Sainik Board portal; verified by the Zila Sainik Board.

scholarships.name: Prime Minister's Research Fellowship (PMRF)
scholarships.amountNote: ₹70,000/month (yrs 1–2), ₹75,000 (yr 3), ₹80,000 (yrs 4–5) + ₹2 lakh/yr research grant
scholarships.deadlineNote: Current cycle; cycles run twice a year
scholarships.specialEligibility: PhD admission at a PMRF granting institution (IITs, IISc, IISERs, NITs, select central universities); CGPA 8.0+ (direct entry)
scholarships.description: India's flagship doctoral fellowship for top students joining PhD programmes at premier institutes in science and technology.
scholarships.process: Get admitted to a PhD at a granting institute, which nominates you; complete the application on the PMRF portal.

scholarships.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Tribe Students
scholarships.amountNote: Course fees (GoI cap ₹2.5 lakh engg / ₹6 lakh MBBS at private institutes) + stipend up to ₹1,200/month (hostellers, professional courses)
scholarships.deadlineNote: State portals; suggested registration window 1 Apr–30 Sep
scholarships.description: Funds ST students in any recognised post-matric course from Class 11 to postgraduate level; extra allowance for students with disabilities.
scholarships.process: Apply on your state/UT scholarship portal (or NSP where the state has none); tracked on dbttribal.gov.in.

scholarships.name: PM YASASVI Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
scholarships.amountNote: Tuition/non-refundable fees + academic allowance (varies by course and state)
scholarships.specialEligibility: Also open to Economically Backward Classes (EBC) and De-notified Tribes (DNT)
scholarships.description: Umbrella scheme (PM YASASVI) supporting OBC, EBC and DNT students in post-matric education.
scholarships.process: Apply on NSP or the state scholarship portal.

scholarships.name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMSS)
scholarships.provider: Department of School Education & Literacy, Ministry of Education
scholarships.amountNote: ₹12,000/year (₹1,000/month) from Class 9 to 12
scholarships.deadlineNote: Application deadline; state exam usually Nov–Dec
scholarships.specialEligibility: Class 8 student of a government / aided / local-body school; must clear the state NMMS exam (MAT + SAT)
scholarships.description: Prevents drop-out after Class 8 by supporting meritorious students from low-income families until Class 12.
scholarships.process: Qualify the state-level NMMS exam, then apply on NSP; renew each year (55% in Class 9/11, 60% in Class 10).

scholarships.name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Minorities
scholarships.amountNote: Admission & tuition fees + maintenance allowance up to ₹1,200/month for hostellers
scholarships.specialEligibility: Minority Community (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi); 30% for girls
scholarships.description: Supports students from notified minority communities from Class 11 to PhD, including ITI and vocational courses.
scholarships.process: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal.

scholarships.name: Ishan Uday Special Scholarship for North Eastern Region
scholarships.amountNote: ₹5,400/month (general degree) or ₹7,800/month (technical/medical/professional), 10 months a year
scholarships.specialEligibility: Domicile of a North-Eastern state; regular (not distance/part-time) UG course
scholarships.description: UGC scholarship that helps students from the North-Eastern Region pursue general, technical and professional undergraduate degrees.
scholarships.process: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal; the institute verifies.

scholarships.name: UGC Junior Research Fellowship (NET-JRF)
scholarships.amountNote: ₹37,000/month (JRF, 2 yrs), ₹42,000/month (SRF, 3 yrs) + HRA + annual contingency
scholarships.deadlineNote: Via UGC-NET, held June and December
scholarships.specialEligibility: Qualify UGC-NET with JRF; age 30 or under at exam (relaxation for OBC-NCL/SC/ST/PwD/women)
scholarships.description: Fellowship for NET-JRF qualified candidates pursuing a PhD in humanities, social sciences and other UGC-NET subjects.
scholarships.process: Qualify UGC-NET (held twice a year by NTA), then join a PhD; the university processes the fellowship.

scholarships.name: National Fellowship for Higher Education of ST Students
scholarships.amountNote: ₹31,000/month (JRF), ₹35,000/month (SRF) + HRA + contingency
scholarships.description: Fellowship for Scheduled Tribe students pursuing MPhil/PhD at recognised universities.
scholarships.process: Apply on the national tribal fellowship portal; selection on PG marks if applicants exceed 750.

scholarships.name: National Scholarship for Higher Education of ST Students (Top Class)
scholarships.amountNote: Full tuition (up to ₹2.5 lakh/yr at private institutes) + ₹3,000/month stipend + ₹5,000 books + ₹45,000 one-time computer
scholarships.specialEligibility: Merit admission to a notified premier institution (not management quota)
scholarships.description: Covers full costs for ST students admitted on merit to notified top institutions (IITs, IIMs, AIIMS, NITs etc.).
scholarships.process: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal.

scholarships.name: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships
scholarships.amountNote: Up to ₹2 lakh over the degree
scholarships.deadlineNote: 2026-27 applications open; check site for closing date
scholarships.specialEligibility: First-year full-time UG students; merit-cum-means with an aptitude test
scholarships.description: Merit-cum-means scholarship for first-year undergraduates in any stream, selected through an online aptitude test.
scholarships.process: Apply online and take the aptitude test; no fee at any stage.

scholarships.name: Reliance Foundation Postgraduate Scholarships
scholarships.amountNote: Up to ₹6 lakh over the degree
scholarships.deadlineNote: 2026-27 applications open; check site for closing date
scholarships.specialEligibility: First-year full-time PG students in engineering, technology, energy and life sciences
scholarships.description: Merit-based scholarship for first-year postgraduates in future-ready science and technology disciplines.
scholarships.process: Apply online; selection on academic merit, aptitude and interview.

scholarships.name: Kotak Kanya Scholarship
scholarships.amountNote: ₹1.5 lakh/year until graduation
scholarships.deadlineNote: Usually closes around September; 2026-27 cycle expected
scholarships.specialEligibility: Admission to an NIRF/NAAC-accredited institution in a professional course
scholarships.description: Supports meritorious girls from low-income families in professional undergraduate degrees at reputed institutions.
scholarships.process: Apply online via Buddy4Study; shortlisted students have a telephonic/virtual interview.

scholarships.name: HDFC Bank Parivartan ECSS Programme
scholarships.amountNote: ₹15,000–₹18,000 (school/diploma), ₹30,000 (general UG), ₹50,000 (professional UG), ₹35,000–₹75,000 (PG)
scholarships.specialEligibility: Preference to students facing a personal/family crisis in the last 3 years
scholarships.description: Educational Crisis Scholarship Support that keeps students from low-income or crisis-hit families in school and college.
scholarships.process: Apply online via Buddy4Study; documents verified followed by a telephonic interview.

scholarships.name: ONGC Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.deadlineNote: Per current cycle; verify on portal
scholarships.specialEligibility: Income limit ₹4.5 lakh for SC/ST, ₹2 lakh for OBC/EWS; age 30 or under
scholarships.description: ONGC's scholarship for SC, ST, OBC and EWS students in engineering, MBBS, MBA and master's in geology/geophysics.
scholarships.process: Apply on the ONGC scholarship portal (NSP registration also required).

scholarships.name: Tata Capital Pankh Scholarship
scholarships.amountNote: Up to 80–100% of fees, capped at ₹10,000–₹15,000 (Class 11-12) or ₹12,000–₹18,000 (UG/diploma); higher for professional UG
scholarships.description: Tata Capital's CSR scholarship covering most of the course fee for students from low-income families.
scholarships.process: Apply online via Buddy4Study.

scholarships.name: Santoor Women's Scholarship
scholarships.amountNote: ₹30,000/year for the 3-year degree
scholarships.specialEligibility: Studied Class 10 and 12 in government schools; joined UG straight after Class 12
scholarships.description: Supports young women from government schools in four states to pursue full-time undergraduate degrees.
scholarships.process: Apply online on the Santoor scholarship portal.

scholarships.name: LIC Golden Jubilee Scholarship
scholarships.provider: Life Insurance Corporation of India (Golden Jubilee Foundation)
scholarships.amountNote: ₹40,000/yr medicine, ₹30,000/yr engineering, ₹20,000/yr other UG/diploma/ITI, ₹15,000 special (after Class 10)
scholarships.specialEligibility: First-year students; passed Class 10/12/diploma in last 3 years
scholarships.description: LIC's scholarship for students from low-income families entering medicine, engineering, other degrees, diplomas or ITI.
scholarships.process: Apply on LIC's Golden Jubilee scholarship portal; selection by divisional office.

scholarships.name: Sitaram Jindal Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.amountNote: ₹500–₹3,200/month depending on course (+₹1,000–1,200 for hostellers)
scholarships.specialEligibility: Minimum marks vary by course and gender (e.g. Class 11-12: boys 60–65%, girls 55–60%)
scholarships.description: Long-running monthly scholarship for students from Class 11 to PG from modest-income families.
scholarships.process: Apply online on the foundation's portal.

scholarships.name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojana
scholarships.provider: Directorate of Higher Education, Government of Maharashtra
scholarships.amountNote: Tuition fee reimbursement: 100% (non-professional, income ≤ ₹8 lakh); professional courses 100% (≤ ₹2.5 lakh) or 50% (₹2.5–8 lakh)
scholarships.deadlineNote: 2026-27 cycle expected; previous cycle closed 30 Sep
scholarships.specialEligibility: Admission through CAP to a government/aided/approved institution; regular courses only
scholarships.description: Maharashtra fee reimbursement scheme (EBC) for open-category and EWS students in higher education.
scholarships.process: Apply on the MahaDBT portal; the college and directorate verify.

scholarships.name: Swami Vivekananda Merit-cum-Means Scholarship (SVMCM)
scholarships.provider: Higher Education Department, Government of West Bengal
scholarships.amountNote: ₹1,000–₹8,000/month depending on course and level
scholarships.specialEligibility: Study in a recognised West Bengal institution; 60% for HS/UG (53–55% for PG)
scholarships.description: West Bengal's merit-cum-means scholarship for meritorious students from low-income families, Class 11 to PG.
scholarships.process: Apply on the SVMCM portal; institute and department verify.

scholarships.name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana (MYSY)
scholarships.amountNote: 50% fee support up to ₹2 lakh/yr (medical), ₹50,000 (engineering), ₹25,000 (diploma), ₹10,000 (other UG) + hostel ₹12,000/yr + books
scholarships.specialEligibility: 80 percentile/marks in Class 10 (for diploma) or Class 12 (for degree)
scholarships.description: Gujarat scheme covering half the fees, hostel and book costs for meritorious students from families earning up to ₹6 lakh.
scholarships.process: Apply on the MYSY portal, then verify documents at a help centre.

scholarships.name: Pudhumai Penn Scheme
scholarships.provider: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
scholarships.amountNote: ₹1,000/month until the course is completed
scholarships.specialEligibility: Studied Class 6–12 in a government school (or govt-aided Tamil-medium school); first higher-education course
scholarships.description: Monthly support for girls from government schools who go on to college, diploma or ITI in Tamil Nadu.
scholarships.process: Applied through the college's nodal officer on the penkalvi portal.

scholarships.name: Vidyasiri Food and Accommodation Scholarship
scholarships.provider: Backward Classes Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka
scholarships.amountNote: ₹1,500/month for 10 months + ₹1,200 book grant
scholarships.deadlineNote: 2026-27 cycle expected; previous cycle closed 31 Aug
scholarships.specialEligibility: Not staying in a government hostel; Category-1 limits shown (stricter for 2A/3A/3B)
scholarships.description: Karnataka support for food and accommodation costs of backward-class students who could not get a government hostel seat.
scholarships.process: Apply on Karnataka's State Scholarship Portal (SSP).

scholarships.name: Fulbright-Nehru Master's Fellowships
scholarships.amountNote: Fully funded: tuition, monthly living stipend, round-trip airfare, J-1 visa support, accident & sickness cover
scholarships.specialEligibility: 3+ years of relevant full-time work experience; Indian citizen resident in India; no prior US degree
scholarships.description: Fully funded master's study in the US for Indian professionals with leadership potential in fields such as public policy, public health, economics and urban planning.
scholarships.process: Apply online to USIEF; shortlisted candidates are interviewed in India.

scholarships.name: Chevening Scholarships
scholarships.amountNote: Fully funded one-year master's: tuition, monthly living allowance, return economy flight, visa fee
scholarships.specialEligibility: 2,800+ hours (~2 years) of work experience; must return home for 2 years after the degree
scholarships.description: The UK government's global scholarship for future leaders to do a one-year master's at any UK university.
scholarships.process: Apply online with four essays and three UK course choices; interviews at the British High Commission.

scholarships.name: Commonwealth Master's Scholarships
scholarships.provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
scholarships.amountNote: Full tuition + £1,712/month stipend (£2,000 in London) + return airfare + study travel grant
scholarships.deadlineNote: CSC portal deadline; India's nominating agency closes earlier
scholarships.specialEligibility: Upper-second-class (2:1) degree; cannot afford UK study otherwise; nominated by national agency (no MBA)
scholarships.description: Fully funded one-year taught master's at a UK university for talented candidates from eligible Commonwealth countries, including India.
scholarships.process: Apply through your national nominating agency (Ministry of Education for India), then on the CSC portal.

scholarships.name: Rhodes Scholarship (India)
scholarships.amountNote: Fully funded postgraduate study at the University of Oxford (fees, stipend, flights, visa)
scholarships.deadlineNote: Opens 1 June, closes ~23 July each year
scholarships.specialEligibility: Exceptional academics, character and leadership; age/eligibility per India constituency rules
scholarships.description: The world's oldest international graduate scholarship; five awards each year for Indian candidates to study at Oxford.
scholarships.process: Apply online; shortlisted candidates attend regional and final interviews.

scholarships.name: Inlaks Shivdasani Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.amountNote: Up to US$120,000 for the course: tuition, living, one-way airfare, health allowance
scholarships.specialEligibility: Admission to a top university in the US, UK or Europe; not for engineering, computer science, medicine or MBA
scholarships.description: Merit scholarship for outstanding Indian graduates to study at top universities in the US, UK and Europe (excludes engineering, CS, medicine, MBA).
scholarships.process: Apply online; shortlisted candidates are interviewed.

scholarships.name: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
scholarships.amountNote: Full cost: tuition + £23,152/yr maintenance + visa, health surcharge, airfares
scholarships.deadlineNote: International round: 8 Dec 2026 or 6 Jan 2027 depending on course
scholarships.specialEligibility: Non-UK citizens applying for a full-time PhD, MLitt or one-year master's at Cambridge (not MBA)
scholarships.description: Full-cost scholarships for outstanding applicants from outside the UK to pursue a postgraduate degree at the University of Cambridge.
scholarships.process: Apply via the Cambridge Applicant Portal and tick the Gates Cambridge box.

scholarships.name: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.provider: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs (via Campus France)
scholarships.amountNote: €1,200/month (master's) or €2,000/month (PhD) + travel, insurance, cultural activities
scholarships.deadlineNote: Institution deadlines Oct–Nov 2026; Campus France closes Jan 2027
scholarships.specialEligibility: Age 29 or under (master's) / 35 or under (PhD); nominated by a French institution
scholarships.description: French government scholarship to attract top international students to master's and PhD programmes in France.
scholarships.process: Apply to the French institution, which nominates you to Campus France.

scholarships.name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships
scholarships.amountNote: CHF 2,450/month (PhD up to 36 months; research fellowship 6–12 months)
scholarships.specialEligibility: Master's completed by Jul 2027; born after 31 Dec 1991; support letter from a Swiss supervisor
scholarships.description: Swiss government PhD scholarships and research fellowships at Swiss universities for graduates from abroad, including India.
scholarships.process: Apply on the GO ESKAS portal via the Swiss embassy channel for India.

scholarships.name: MEXT (Monbukagakusho) Japanese Government Scholarship
scholarships.provider: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology, Japan
scholarships.amountNote: ≈¥143,000–145,000/month (research students), ≈¥117,000 (undergraduate) + full tuition + airfare
scholarships.deadlineNote: Embassy route usually opens ~April; exams May–June
scholarships.specialEligibility: Embassy recommendation route: written test and interview
scholarships.description: Japanese government scholarship covering tuition, a monthly stipend and airfare for research, undergraduate and other programmes in Japan.
scholarships.process: Apply through the Embassy of Japan in India (written exam and interview) or via a Japanese university.

scholarships.name: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS)
scholarships.provider: National Institute for International Education (NIIED), Korea
scholarships.amountNote: ≈KRW 900,000/month + tuition (up to KRW 5 million), airfare, settlement, language and completion grants, insurance
scholarships.specialEligibility: 80% CGPA or top 20% of class; age under 25 (UG) / under 40 (graduate); 78 seats reserved for India
scholarships.description: Korean government scholarship for undergraduate and graduate degrees in Korea, including a year of Korean language training.
scholarships.process: Apply via the embassy track or directly to a Korean university (university track).

scholarships.name: J.N. Tata Endowment Loan Scholarship
scholarships.provider: J.N. Tata Endowment for the Higher Education of Indians
scholarships.amountNote: Loan scholarship of ₹1–10 lakh (some sources say up to ₹20 lakh) at 2% simple interest; travel grant possible
scholarships.deadlineNote: Opens January, closes around end-January / March each year
scholarships.specialEligibility: Indian graduates with an admission offer abroad; partly loan (repayable)
scholarships.description: Century-old Tata endowment providing low-interest loan scholarships to Indian graduates for postgraduate study abroad.
scholarships.process: Apply online, followed by a test and interview.

scholarships.name: Holland Scholarship
scholarships.provider: Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science & Dutch universities (Nuffic)
scholarships.amountNote: €5,000 one-time in the first year
scholarships.deadlineNote: Usually 1 Feb or 1 May, set by each university
scholarships.specialEligibility: Non-EEA students starting a bachelor's or master's at a participating Dutch institution; country list set by each university
scholarships.description: One-time grant for talented non-EEA students starting a full-time degree at a participating Dutch university or university of applied sciences.
scholarships.process: Apply through the Dutch institution's own scholarship procedure after applying for admission.

scholarships.name: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarship (GOI-IES)
scholarships.amountNote: €10,000 stipend + full tuition waiver for one year
scholarships.specialEligibility: Non-EU/EEA students accepted at an Irish higher education institution (final-year UG, master's, PhD); confirm current eligible-country list
scholarships.description: Irish government scholarship offering a stipend and fee waiver for one year of study in Ireland.
scholarships.process: Apply online to the HEA; institutions confirm admission.

scholarships.name: K.C. Mahindra Scholarships for Post-Graduate Studies Abroad
scholarships.amountNote: Interest-free loan scholarship: up to ₹10 lakh (top 3 Fellows) / up to ₹5 lakh (others)
scholarships.deadlineNote: Per current cycle; verify on site
scholarships.specialEligibility: First-class degree; admission (or application) to a reputed foreign university; repayable interest-free
scholarships.description: Interest-free loan scholarships from the Mahindra group's education trust for Indian graduates pursuing postgraduate study abroad.
scholarships.process: Apply online; shortlisted candidates are interviewed.

scholarships.name: Aga Khan Foundation International Scholarship Programme
scholarships.amountNote: Tuition and living expenses: 50% grant + 50% loan (5% annual service charge)
scholarships.specialEligibility: Outstanding students with no other means of financing; preference for under-30s; resident in India
scholarships.description: Need-based scholarship-loan for postgraduate study abroad for outstanding students from select developing countries, including India.
scholarships.process: Apply to the Aga Khan Foundation office in India.

scholarships.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's Scholarships
scholarships.amountNote: €1,400/month + full tuition + up to €3,000/yr travel & installation + insurance
scholarships.specialEligibility: Study in at least two European countries; apply to each joint programme separately
scholarships.description: EU-funded scholarships for joint master's programmes run by consortia of universities across two or more European countries.
scholarships.process: Choose programmes from the Erasmus Mundus catalogue and apply on each programme's own portal.

scholarships.name: Mitacs Globalink Research Internship (AICTE)
scholarships.amountNote: Fully funded 12-week research internship: airfare, housing, food stipend, insurance
scholarships.specialEligibility: Full-time BE/BTech student with 1–3 semesters remaining; age 18+
scholarships.description: Summer research internship at Canadian universities for senior Indian engineering undergraduates, under the Mitacs–AICTE partnership.
scholarships.process: Apply to 3–10 projects across at least three Canadian provinces.

scholarships.name: GREAT Scholarships – India
scholarships.provider: British Council & UK universities (GREAT Britain campaign)
scholarships.amountNote: At least £10,000 towards tuition for a one-year master's
scholarships.specialEligibility: Indian citizens; offer from a participating UK university (list changes each year)
scholarships.description: Tuition scholarships from participating UK universities for Indian students on one-year postgraduate courses.
scholarships.process: Apply for admission to a participating university, then apply for its GREAT scholarship.

scholarships.name: Knight-Hennessy Scholars
scholarships.amountNote: Full funding for up to 3 years of Stanford graduate study: tuition, living & academic stipend, annual travel
scholarships.deadlineNote: 2027 cohort closed 6 Oct 2026; usually opens June
scholarships.specialEligibility: Apply to a full-time Stanford graduate programme; open to all nationalities
scholarships.description: Stanford's flagship graduate scholarship providing full funding and leadership development to scholars from around the world.
scholarships.process: Submit the Knight-Hennessy application and a separate Stanford graduate programme application.

scholarships.name: Charpak Master's Scholarship
scholarships.provider: Embassy of France in India (Campus France India)
scholarships.amountNote: €860/month + visa and Campus France fee waiver + health insurance + housing priority
scholarships.deadlineNote: Usually early in the year; interviews in April
scholarships.specialEligibility: Indian citizen or OCI; age 30 or under; admitted to a full-time master's in France
scholarships.description: French government scholarship for Indian students pursuing a full-time master's degree in France.
scholarships.process: Apply on the Institut Français India scholarship portal; shortlisted candidates have an online interview.

scholarships.name: DAAD WISE (Working Internships in Science and Engineering)
scholarships.amountNote: €934/month for 2–3 months + travel subsidy (~€1,075) + health insurance
scholarships.specialEligibility: 85% aggregate / 8.5 CGPA; invitation from a German professor at a public university or research institute
scholarships.description: Summer research internship in Germany for top Indian undergraduate science and engineering students.
scholarships.process: Secure a host professor, then apply on the DAAD portal.

scholarships.name: Fulbright-Nehru Doctoral Research Fellowships
scholarships.amountNote: 6–9 months in the US: monthly stipend, round-trip airfare, J-1 visa support, health cover, affiliation fees
scholarships.specialEligibility: Registered for a PhD at an Indian institution; not a government employee; priority fields change yearly
scholarships.description: Lets Indian PhD scholars spend 6–9 months doing research at a US institution.
scholarships.process: Apply online via USIEF/IIE portal; shortlisted candidates interviewed.
